description:
The corresponding genes of a Chinese Spring gene in the other bread wheat genome assemblies of the 21-genome
pangenome: Ensembl Plants Compara orthologues in ArinaLrFor, Jagger, Julius, Kariega, Lancer, Landmark, Mace,
Mattis, Norin 61, Paragon, Renan and Stanley, each with its gene ID, chromosome position and a link to this
site's genome browser for that assembly. gene: symbol or any IWGSC ID. same_subgenome_only keeps the copy on the
same subgenome as the query (Compara also lists the homoeologous copies). Cultivars without a Compara orthologue,
and assemblies outside Compara (Cadenza, Claire, Robigus, Weebil, Fielder, Zang1817, Attraktion, Aikang 58), are
listed: search those with blast_sequence against their genome database.
name: wheat_gene_in_cultivars
